title: 7 Best AI Marketing Software for Local Businesses in 2026 | Frizerly Blog

facts.fact: Frizerly's vendor-published case study for a specialty building-materials retailer reports that the business published 276 posts over approximately 12 months without in-house writers.
facts.quote: the business published 276 posts over approximately 12 months without in-house writers

facts.fact: In Frizerly's building-materials case study, 136 of the 276 posts earned clicks in the measured 30-day period, and the top 25 posts generated more than 3,600 organic clicks.
facts.quote: In the measured 30-day period, 136 of those posts earned clicks and the top 25 generated more than 3,600 organic clicks.

facts.fact: Frizerly's vendor-published optometry case study reports 360 published articles, 72 blog pages receiving clicks, and more than 600 monthly organic clicks from blog content during its measured period.
facts.quote: reported 360 published articles, 72 blog pages receiving clicks and more than 600 monthly organic clicks from blog content during its measured period.

facts.fact: The optometry case study's figures describe organic search clicks, not bookings or revenue, according to the article.
facts.quote: These figures describe organic search clicks, not bookings or revenue, and they do not imply that publishing the same number of articles will produce the same result

facts.fact: The article's comparison features seven AI marketing software options for local businesses.
facts.quote: The seven options worth comparing are Frizerly for an integrated organic marketing workflow, Semrush Local for Google Business Profile work

facts.fact: The article's evaluation framework uses five questions: discovery, execution, trust, conversion and measurement.
facts.quote: We use five questions when assessing these tools:

facts.fact: The article suggests treating the first 90 days of a local AI marketing program as a learning cycle.
facts.quote: We suggest treating the first 90 days as a learning cycle.

facts.fact: The article advises against judging a new local AI marketing program on a single week of rankings because search results often take longer to develop.
facts.quote: Search results often take longer to develop, so do not judge a new program on one week's rankings.

facts.fact: The article's suggested first-90-day plan includes a first phase covering days 1 to 30, focused on establishing what is true and what customers ask.
facts.quote: ### Days 1 to 30: Establish what is true and what customers ask

facts.fact: The article's suggested first-90-day plan includes a second phase covering days 31 to 60, focused on publishing, distributing and checking the handoff.
facts.quote: ### Days 31 to 60: Publish, distribute and check the handoff

facts.fact: The blog states that AI marketing software cannot promise a particular Google Maps position, because the searcher's location, the business's relevance and the surrounding competition all affect what that person sees.
facts.quote: It cannot promise a particular Maps position. A searcher's location, the business's relevance and the surrounding competition all affect what that person sees.

facts.fact: The blog defines answer engine optimization (AEO) as focusing on making information clear and useful when AI systems answer questions.
facts.quote: Answer engine optimization, or AEO, focuses on making information clear and useful when AI systems answer questions.

facts.fact: The blog states that AI citations and recommendations are not guaranteed, so they should be monitored separately from organic search clicks.
facts.quote: AI citations and recommendations are not guaranteed, so monitor them separately from organic search clicks.

facts.fact: The blog advises businesses to compare a consistent set of relevant AI-search questions over time and to treat any single answer as a snapshot rather than a guaranteed outcome.
facts.quote: Compare a consistent set of relevant AI-search questions over time, recording whether your business is mentioned. Treat any one answer as a snapshot rather than a guaranteed outcome.

facts.fact: The blog states that for review replies the business, not the software, owns the response.
facts.quote: The business, not the software, owns the response.
